title: El pescado
goal: Buy fish and be able to tell whether it is fresh
culture: Guapote and mojarra come out of Cocibolca and they come in at dawn. Asking whether it is from today is expected rather than insulting, and he will tell you the truth, because you live here now and he will see you next week.

beats.good: Asking is expected. What would be strange, and what would mark you as somebody passing through, is not asking.

beats.objective: Ask whether it came in today
beats.good: Fresco is an opinion; de hoy is a fact. This is the question behind the question and he will answer it straight.

beats.es: De hoy, de la madrugada. ¿Se lo limpio?
beats.say: Sí, me lo limpia, por favor.
beats.en: Yes, clean it for me, please.
ok: si me lo limpia por favor
beats.good: He guts and scales it on the spot and does not charge for it. Saying no to that is a decision, not a saving.
Entero — whole. A guapote is fried whole here, head and all, and asking for fillets marks you out more than your accent does.
